title: 污泥熱水解前處理~Thermal-hydrolysis sludge pretreatment
focus: 熱水解前處理與消化系統整合~Thermal-hydrolysis pretreatment and digestion integration
summary: 本課以熱水解前處理與消化系統整合為主線，從污泥組成與進料邊界、水解顯熱模型、蒸汽熱焓收支、熱回收與溫位進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops thermal-hydrolysis pretreatment and digestion integration through ten connected units, beginning with sludge composition and feed boundary, hydrolysis sensible-heat model, steam enthalpy balance, recovery and temperature grade. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 污泥組成與進料邊界~Sludge composition and feed boundary
units.mechanism: 初沉與生物污泥的可水解性不同，先確認混合比例與乾固體。~Primary and biological sludges differ in hydrolysability; establish blend and dry solids first.
units.model: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。~Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「污泥組成與進料邊界」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge composition and feed boundary. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只看濕重忽略組成。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。~Wet weight alone hides composition. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry mass from representative solids samples, without mixing wet mass.
units.misconception: 所有污泥都具有相同熱水解反應。~All sludges respond identically to thermal hydrolysis.
units.practice: 只改變 TS:0.04→0.05，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2000 變為 2500 kg DS/d。用「污泥組成與進料邊界」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only TS:0.04→0.05, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2000 to 2500 kg DS/d. Explain the direction using sludge composition and feed boundary, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 水解顯熱模型~Hydrolysis sensible-heat model
units.mechanism: 教學模型以質量與溫升估算基本熱量，壓力容器狀態必須另行分析。~Use mass and temperature rise for basic teaching heat estimates; pressure-vessel states require separate analysis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：m=1000 kg；cp=4 kJ/(kg·K)；教學升溫 ΔT=100 K。模型 Q=m cp ΔT，代入得到 400 MJ。適用邊界：教學顯熱估計，並非壓力容器操作溫度或程序。~Original teaching assumptions: m=1000 kg; cp=4 kJ/(kg·K); teaching temperature rise ΔT=100 K. Model Q=m cp ΔT gives 400 MJ. Applicability: Teaching sensible-heat estimate, not pressure-vessel operating temperature or procedure.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「水解顯熱模型」的觀測點。以封閉示意圖查找熱交換、蒸汽冷凝與損失項。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for hydrolysis sensible-heat model. Locate heat exchange, steam condensation and loss terms on a closed-system diagram. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把顯熱式當作整套蒸汽設計。診斷與介入：補列熱損、回熱與物性，不以此式設定壓力容器。~Using sensible heat as a complete steam-system design fails. Diagnostic response: Add losses, heat recovery and material properties; do not use this equation to set a pressure vessel.
units.misconception: 只知道槽容即可決定所有熱需求。~Vessel volume determines all thermal requirements.
units.practice: 只改變 ΔT:100→110 K，其餘假設固定；結果應由 400 變為 440 MJ。用「水解顯熱模型」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only ΔT:100→110 K, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 400 to 440 MJ. Explain the direction using hydrolysis sensible-heat model, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 蒸汽熱焓收支~Steam enthalpy balance
units.mechanism: 蒸汽供熱取決於進出熱焓差，不能把蒸汽公斤數直接當能量。~Steam heating depends on inlet/outlet enthalpy difference, not mass alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：熱需求=400 MJ；假設有效冷凝放熱=2 MJ/kg。模型 ms=Q/huse，代入得到 200 kg steam。適用邊界：選定熱焓差的平衡例；蒸汽壓力、冷凝水與閥件不可由此例設計。~Original teaching assumptions: Heat demand=400 MJ; assumed useful condensation heat=2 MJ/kg. Model ms=Q/huse gives 200 kg steam. Applicability: Balance using an assumed useful enthalpy difference; not a design of steam pressure, condensate or valves.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「蒸汽熱焓收支」的觀測點。按實際熱焓狀態與冷凝水回收邊界重列能量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for steam enthalpy balance. Rebuild the energy balance using actual enthalpy states and condensate boundary. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 忽略冷凝水返回狀態。診斷與介入：採用一致蒸汽及冷凝水熱焓基準，關閉能量收支。~Ignoring returning condensate state distorts the balance. Diagnostic response: Use consistent steam/condensate enthalpy bases and close the energy balance.
units.misconception: 每公斤蒸汽在任何狀態都有相同可用熱。~Every kilogram of steam has identical usable heat.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:400→440 MJ，其餘假設固定；結果應由 200 變為 220 kg steam。用「蒸汽熱焓收支」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:400→440 MJ, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 200 to 220 kg steam. Explain the direction using steam enthalpy balance, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 熱回收與溫位~Recovery and temperature grade
units.mechanism: 閃蒸與熱交換可回收熱，但低溫熱未必能供應高溫需求。~Flash/heat exchange recover energy, but low-grade heat cannot necessarily satisfy high-temperature demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：可回收熱源=400 MJ；假設回收率=0.65。模型 Qrec=Qη，代入得到 260 MJ。適用邊界：只按能量回收率，不包含溫位與換熱最小溫差限制。~Original teaching assumptions: Available heat=400 MJ; assumed recovery fraction=0.65. Model Qrec=Qη gives 260 MJ. Applicability: Energy-fraction estimate only; temperature grade and minimum approach are omitted.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「熱回收與溫位」的觀測點。畫出冷熱物流溫度區間，確認回收熱仍有可用溫差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for recovery and temperature grade. Plot hot/cold temperature ranges and check usable driving temperature difference. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把所有回收熱視為同等有用。診斷與介入：核對熱源與熱需求溫位，避免把低溫回熱全算可用。~Treating recovered heat of every temperature as equally useful fails. Diagnostic response: Check source/demand temperature grades before counting recovered heat as usable.
units.misconception: 能量相等就可直接交換任何熱源。~Equal energy makes any heat sources interchangeable.
units.practice: 只改變 η:0.65→0.75，其餘假設固定；結果應由 260 變為 300 MJ。用「熱回收與溫位」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only η:0.65→0.75, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 260 to 300 MJ. Explain the direction using recovery and temperature grade, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 批次排程~Batch scheduling
units.mechanism: 多批次共用蒸汽與下游容量，整數批次和等待時間決定日產能。~Shared steam and downstream capacity make whole batches and waits decisive for daily throughput.
units.model: 原創教學假設：每批=8 t wet；循環=2 h；每天可用=20 h。模型 Mday=Mbatch floor(tavail/tcycle)，代入得到 80 t wet/d。適用邊界：完整批次數取整數，需另扣清洗、等待與異常，不是承諾產能。~Original teaching assumptions: Batch mass=8 t wet; cycle=2 h; available time=20 h/d. Model Mday=Mbatch floor(tavail/tcycle) gives 80 t wet/d. Applicability: Count whole batches; cleaning, waits and faults require deductions, so this is not guaranteed throughput.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「批次排程」的觀測點。建立批次事件時間表，檢查共同蒸汽源是否衝突。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for batch scheduling. Build an event schedule and check conflicts for the shared steam source. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 用小數批次虛增產能。診斷與介入：把清洗、停機與不完整批次明列，再調整排程。~Fractional batches inflate throughput. Diagnostic response: List cleaning, downtime and incomplete batches before revising the schedule.
units.misconception: 一天可完成 8.7 個完整批次。~A day can complete 8.7 whole batches.
units.practice: 只改變 tcycle:2→2.5 h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 80 變為 64 t wet/d。用「批次排程」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only tcycle:2→2.5 h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 80 to 64 t wet/d. Explain the direction using batch scheduling, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 水解後消化負荷~Post-hydrolysis digestion load
units.mechanism: 溶解化提高可利用性，也可能形成更快的酸負荷，須與產甲烷能力相配。~Solubilization increases availability and potentially acid-loading rate; match it to methanogenic capacity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：VS 進料=1500 kg/d；消化容積=1000 m³。模型 OLR=MVS/V，代入得到 1.5 kg VS/(m³·d)。適用邊界：只描述有機負荷，不代表可承受上限；VS 與 COD 不可混稱。~Original teaching assumptions: VS feed=1500 kg/d; digester volume=1000 m³. Model OLR=MVS/V gives 1.5 kg VS/(m³·d). Applicability: Organic loading only, not an allowable limit; VS and COD are distinct bases.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「水解後消化負荷」的觀測點。量進料體積與 VS、並與溫度及酸鹼趨勢配對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for post-hydrolysis digestion load. Measure feed volume and VS and pair with temperature/acidity trends. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 水解有效就無限制增加消化進料。診斷與介入：查 VS 進料與有效槽容，將酸鹼及產氣趨勢一同判讀。~Successful hydrolysis does not justify unlimited digester loading. Diagnostic response: Check VS feed/effective volume together with acidity and gas trends.
units.misconception: 水解後不再需要生物消化。~Hydrolyzed sludge no longer needs biological digestion.
units.practice: 只改變 MVS:1500→1800 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1.5 變為 1.8 kg VS/(m³·d)。用「水解後消化負荷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only MVS:1500→1800 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1.5 to 1.8 kg VS/(m³·d). Explain the direction using post-hydrolysis digestion load, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 冷卻與稀釋介面~Cooling and dilution interface
units.mechanism: 消化進料介面需同時平衡溫度、流量與濃度，不能只滿足其中一項。~Balance temperature, flow and concentration simultaneously at the digestion interface.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=1000 m³；Q=50 m³/d。模型 θ=V/Q，代入得到 20 d。適用邊界：均勻流體名義停留時間；固體停留與有效容積可能不同。~Original teaching assumptions: V=1000 m³; Q=50 m³/d. Model θ=V/Q gives 20 d. Applicability: Nominal fluid residence time; solids residence and effective volume may differ.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「冷卻與稀釋介面」的觀測點。用實際進出料紀錄及槽內沉積估計有效容積。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for cooling and dilution interface. Use feed/discharge records and sediment accumulation to estimate effective volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 為降溫大量稀釋卻縮短停留。診斷與介入：查沉積與浮渣占據空間，重估有效停留。~Heavy cooling dilution shortens residence. Diagnostic response: Check volume lost to deposits/scum and re-estimate effective residence.
units.misconception: 稀釋只改濃度不改停留時間。~Dilution changes concentration without affecting residence.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:50→60 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 20 變為 16.666667 d。用「冷卻與稀釋介面」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:50→60 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 20 to 16.666667 d. Explain the direction using cooling and dilution interface, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 溶解氨回流~Soluble-ammonium recycle
units.mechanism: 水解與消化改變氮的液固分配，脫水回流氨應納入主水線。~Hydrolysis/digestion shift nitrogen partitioning; include dewatering ammonium returns in the water line.
units.model: 原創教學假設：回流水 Q=80 m³/d；NH4-N=600 mg/L。模型 LN=QCN/1000，代入得到 48 kg N/d。適用邊界：日平均回流負荷；瞬時排放會造成更高的時段尖峰。~Original teaching assumptions: Return liquid Q=80 m³/d; NH4-N=600 mg/L. Model LN=QCN/1000 gives 48 kg N/d. Applicability: Daily mean recycle load; batch discharge causes larger short-term peaks.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「溶解氨回流」的觀測點。記錄脫水運行時段、回流量與氨氮。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for soluble-ammonium recycle. Record dewatering hours, recycle flow and ammonium. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只計水解產氣而漏掉回流負荷。診斷與介入：將側流量與氨氮同步採樣，納入主流水線負荷。~Energy-only accounting misses recycle loading. Diagnostic response: Sample sidestream flow/ammonium synchronously and include them in mainstream load.
units.misconception: 有機氮分解後氮負荷會自動消失。~Organic-N breakdown automatically removes nitrogen load.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:80→100 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 48 變為 60 kg N/d。用「溶解氨回流」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:80→100 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 48 to 60 kg N/d. Explain the direction using soluble-ammonium recycle, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 脫水效益辨識~Dewatering-benefit assessment
units.mechanism: 比較前後泥餅含固率時，必須固定乾固體輸入與聚合物基準。~Compare cake solids at fixed dry-solids input and polymer basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：DS=2000 kg/d；泥餅 TS=0.25。模型 Mcake=MDS/TS，代入得到 8000 kg wet cake/d。適用邊界：假定乾固體完全進入泥餅；實際需校正捕集率。~Original teaching assumptions: DS=2000 kg/d; cake TS=0.25. Model Mcake=MDS/TS gives 8000 kg wet cake/d. Applicability: Assumes all dry solids enter the cake; correct for actual capture.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「脫水效益辨識」的觀測點。稱泥餅並分析含固率，與進料 DS 閉合。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for dewatering-benefit assessment. Weigh cake, analyze solids fraction and close against feed DS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 含固率上升被誤算成乾固體消失。診斷與介入：同步量乾固體與泥餅重量，查固體回收率是否變化。~Higher cake solids are mistaken for lost dry solids. Diagnostic response: Measure dry solids and wet cake together and check capture changes.
units.misconception: 泥餅變乾代表污染物質量等比減少。~Drier cake means proportional contaminant-mass reduction.
units.practice: 只改變 TS:0.25→0.30，其餘假設固定；結果應由 8000 變為 6666.6667 kg wet cake/d。用「脫水效益辨識」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only TS:0.25→0.30, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 8000 to 6666.6667 kg wet cake/d. Explain the direction using dewatering-benefit assessment, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 整體能源驗證~Whole-system energy verification
units.mechanism: 熱水解的新增熱耗應與消化產氣、回收熱及輔機共同核算。~Account for added THP heat alongside digestion gas, heat recovery and auxiliaries.
units.model: 原創教學假設：毛發電=1000 kWh/d；壓縮、乾燥與輔機=180 kWh/d。模型 Enet=Egross-Eaux，代入得到 820 kWh/d。適用邊界：同一系統邊界；熱回收收益不可重複算入電量。~Original teaching assumptions: Gross generation=1000 kWh/d; compression, drying and auxiliaries=180 kWh/d. Model Enet=Egross-Eaux gives 820 kWh/d. Applicability: Use one system boundary; recovered heat must not be double-counted as electricity.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「整體能源驗證」的觀測點。用分表列出每一輔機與可用餘熱。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for whole-system energy verification. Submeter each auxiliary and report usable waste heat separately. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只列增加產氣而省略蒸汽成本。診斷與介入：核對每個附屬電表與能源邊界，分列熱能和電能。~Counting extra gas while omitting steam burden overstates benefit. Diagnostic response: Check auxiliary meters/energy boundaries and separate heat from electricity.
units.misconception: 產氣增加就必定有正淨能源。~More gas always means positive net energy.
units.practice: 只改變 Eaux:180→240 kWh/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 820 變為 760 kWh/d。用「整體能源驗證」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Eaux:180→240 kWh/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 820 to 760 kWh/d. Explain the direction using whole-system energy verification, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
